renameDocumentDescription: Versions and old links are retained. Keep the same file extension.
unableToRenameDocument: Could not rename. Check the name and extension, close open editors and refresh if the document changed. Existing files are never overwritten.
documentRenamePreservedOriginal: The document was renamed. The previous file was retained because its safe removal could not be verified.
availableAgentHelp: Only idle agents linked to neither a task nor a deliverable are listed. Their history, name and working folder are preserved.
availableAgentsError: Unable to load available agents. Close and reopen this dialog to retry.
noAvailableAgents: No available agents in this project.
deliverableFolderSelectionHelp: Choose a local workspace and an existing folder. This does not move files or change existing document links.
deliverableFolderSelectionFailed: Could not select this folder. Check that it exists in an available workspace and that you have access.
lifecycleDraftDefinition: The deliverable is being defined. Its content and validation criteria can still be prepared.
lifecycleConstitutionDefinition: The documents are being created or revised, by people or agents.
lifecycleValidationDefinition: The finalized deliverable requires approval of its document versions before it can be considered validated.
lifecycleFinalizedDefinition: The deliverable is complete. When validation is required, its document versions have been approved. Reopen it to resume work.
lifecycleArchivedDefinition: The deliverable is kept for reference. Unarchive it before resuming work.
labelsAiFailed: AI classification failed. Your organization is unchanged.
labelsStale: Documents changed: the outdated proposal was not applied.
labelsError: Unable to update organization. Refresh and try again.
labelsVirtualExplanation: Labels group documents without moving or duplicating files.
labelsAutomaticPolicy: Labels configured by an administrator are reviewed by AI after classification or a new version. Only existing labels can be reused.
labelsDeleteExplanation: Deleting the label preserves every document and its history.
labelsDeleteAssigned: Warning: this label is assigned to {{count}} document(s). It will automatically be removed from these documents.
labelsProposalExplanation: AI uses document names, formats and labels. It may propose creating or deleting labels and reclassifying all documents. Nothing changes until you approve.
labelsPreferenceFailed: Unable to save your display preference.
documentsDrop: Drop files here to add them
documentsDropVersion: On an existing document: a new version, with history preserved.
documentsReplaceExplanation: “{{name}}” will become version {{version}}. The previous version, links and labels will be preserved.
documentsDuplicateVersion: Files whose names already exist will be saved as new versions.
documentsDropSingle: Drop a single file on a document to add a version.
deleteProtectedDeliverable: Finalized or archived deliverable: administrator deletion only.
taskNoAvailableDeliverables: No editable deliverable without a primary task. You can create one.
taskLinkFailed: Unable to link. The task or deliverable may have changed. Refresh and try again.
documentsSameFormat: The new version must keep the document format.
